messages:
nina: FYI I'm hitting duplicate fragment errors on the docusaurus build for the migration guide. Looks like headings with inline HTML comments are collapsing into the same slug.

liam: Can you paste an example? I've seen HTML comments inside headings strip out text and then two headings end up generating identical ids.

nina: Minimal example from the page: 
```mdx
## Migration plan <!-- keep this for audit -->
Some text...

## Migration plan
More details...
```
When rendered both headings become `migration-plan` so linkcheck complains about duplicate fragments.

docs-bot: build failed ")Duplicate fragment id 'migration-plan' found" on /docs/migration (docusaurus build).

pat: Oof. Docusaurus slugify removes html comments which means headings that only differ by comment content collapse. We should sanitize headings in the docs pipeline or reject HTML comments in headings.

gina: Quick options: 1) remove inline comments from headings, 2) append a zero-width char in second heading (yuck), 3) update preprocess to strip comments before slugify and add a linter rule to fail on identical visible heading text.

liam: I prefer 1 + linter. Easier for authors and predictable slugs. Add a migration note for the older pages that used generated comments.

nina: I'll open a small PR that strips HTML comments inside heading nodes during build and adds a remark-lint rule that flags headings containing HTML comments. Also will run a repo-wide grep to find hits.

pat: For the grep: `git grep -n "<!--.*-->" -- docs | sed -n 's/:.*$//p' | sort -u` should show files.

docs-bot: CI queued for PR 4621 (docusaurus build + linkcheck).

liam: Ran the grep locally, found four docs pages with inline heading comments (mostly legacy migration snippets). Pushing fixups to the branch.

docs-bot: linkcheck reported 4 duplicate fragment warnings before patch, 0 after patch.

nina: PR 4621 includes: 1) strip comments in heading slugify, 2) remark-lint plugin to fail on heading HTML comments, 3) migration note in docs/migration.md listing likely affected pages. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4621

gina: Nice. Can we add a unit test for the slugify behavior? The runtime bug was tricky.

liam: Added a small jest snapshot test to cover `slugifyHeading('Migration plan <!--keep-->')` -> `migration-plan`.

docs-bot: build passed for PR 4621 :white_check_mark: linkcheck OK.

pat: Merged. Heads up: added a short migration blurb in the CHANGELOG and pinged support to watch for any customer reports.

nina: Closing this thread — thanks everyone. If anyone sees funny anchor errors post-merge please reopen.

gina: thanks :raised_hands:
